overlapHandling.description:
The field specified how overlapping points should be handled. If multiple points overlap, here how they behave
under the following enum values:
SUM - addition of all the values from all the points
AVG - average value of all the points (default)
MIN - minimum value across all the points
MAX - maximum value across all the points

aggFunc.description:
Overlap handling to be applied when converting the objects to a time series (optional, null treated as AVG).
When multiple points overlap due to overlapping `start` and `end`, this field will be used to aggregate points.

requestedData.description:
When a Timeseries is created, different category of data can be requested
e.g.
1. actual normalized values for the {@link aggFunc} provided
2. Earliest/Latest value or date time of the underlying series generated
3. what intervals are estimated
In order to retrieve non standard (simple aggregated provided via #aggFunc), use this field

valueExpr.description:
Specifies how to extract the value information from the object
This field is required, with the exception of when the #aggFunc field is set to `COUNT` or `ROLLINGCOUNT`.
Note that this field must return a primitive data type that will be converted into a double value.

dataVersionExpr.description:
The expression for evaluating the data version of the data point
This field is used for resolving conflicts in scenarios where two points are for the same time period but have
different versions. The data point with a higher data version will be chosen.

isEstimatedExpr.description:
The expression for evaluating if the data point value is estimated or not. This can be used in reporting whether
the data for every interval is estimated or not, for downstream analysis and reporting.
For example, if a bill was an estimated for a month, then while returning the time series, it is useful to indicate
that the month's bill was estimated and not actual.
If both actual and estimated is provided for the same period, the actual value will be chosen.

title: Type describing parameters that are needed to construct a Timeseries for provided field values
